entries.label: Router Conditional Approvals
entries.text: Netgear’s listed Nighthawk and Orbi consumer routers, along with its cable gateways and cable modems, have conditional approval from April 14, 2026, through October 1, 2027.

archive.label: EA Security 3.0
archive.text: For purposes of the Covered List, routers are defined as consumer-grade networking devices primarily intended for residential use that can be installed by the customer and forward data packets between networked systems. The Commission identified all three elements as required for a device to qualify as a router.
